profile.subtitleJa: ヤコブの妻として語られる祖先
profile.summaryJa: ルツ記4章11節で、門にいた人々と長老たちは、ルツがラケルとレアのようにイスラエルの家を築くよう祝福します。

wikipedia.title: Rachel
wikipedia.noteJa: 記事は創世記の族長ヤコブの妻ラケルを扱います。ルツ記4章11節の祝福に現れる祖先への参照先として示します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, “We are witnesses. May the LORD make the woman who has come into your house like Rachel and like Leah, which both built the house of Israel; and treat you worthily in Ephrathah, and be famous in Bethlehem.
